title: LLM-Based Long-Tail Query Rewriting in Taobao Search
summary: This community centers on the paper 'Large Language Model based Long-tail Query Rewriting in Taobao Search,' published in the Companion Proceedings of the ACM on Web Conference 2024. The work is authored by a collaborative team of nine researchers, including Enhong Chen, Tong Xu, and Wenjun Peng. The paper addresses the specific challenge of improving search relevance for long-tail queries within the Taobao e-commerce platform using Large Language Models.
key_findings: The paper was published in the Companion Proceedings of the ACM on Web Conference 2024 (WWW 2024) in Singapore.
The authorship team consists of nine individuals: Wenjun Peng, Guiyang Li, Yue Jiang, Zilong Wang, Dan Ou, Xiaoyi Zeng, Derong Xu, Tong Xu, and Enhong Chen.
The research focuses specifically on the application of Large Language Models (LLMs) for query rewriting tasks.
The target domain of the research is the Taobao search engine, specifically addressing long-tail query issues.
The paper appears in the reference list of a broader technical survey, situated between works on Knowledge Graph Link Prediction and Patent Phrase Similarity.
The publication date of the survey document containing this reference is September 2024.
